question: Can any of 27 v13 18-24 ka Alnus pollen taxon-ID candidate records be unambiguously linked, at SAMPLE level, to a calibrated age-depth chronology and sufficient taxonomic identification in the six prior-fixed source datasets?

source_diagnostic.validation: Only HTTP 200 JSON and dataset ID direct provenance; never count generic taxon-name hits. Save response SHA and serialized JSON in workflow artifact to permit later inspection.
source_diagnostic.field_inventory: Exact nested keys and data types for dataset, default chronology, sample ages, analysis unit IDs, taxon IDs, age types, age controls; no inference of linkage from key proximity.
source_diagnostic.negative_control: invalid download source must NOT contain a normal nonempty target dataset
source_diagnostic.uncertainty: Original occurrence may be in a different sample chronology than first download. Dataset age ranges and pollen label do not certify exact sample calibration.

admission_gate: Only original exact dataset/site/occurrence/taxon IDs are eligible
Trace each sample to its explicit sampleage.chronologyid and age-model units; age-age bounds must cover 18-24 ka calibrated BP for probabilistic ancient occupancy
If sample has no explicit chronology assignment, label UNRESOLVED rather than guess default
Review original age-depth controls and source publication/DOI; radiocarbon BP cannot be taken as calibrated years BP without proper source calibration
Species-level pollen morphological diagnostics independent; a source label Alnus glutinosa is not itself proof
No new positive species or dataset selection based on LGM model scores, genetic response or outcome tuning
